runs.name: design an LQR and drive a double integrator to the origin
runs.cmd: pip install -q -c $HARNESS/world_constraints.txt numpy scipy matplotlib >/dev/null 2>&1 && MPLBACKEND=Agg PYTHONPATH=. python $HARNESS/drv.py

notes: numpy/scipy are pip-installed; the acquired python-control source itself is run via PYTHONPATH=. (the fossil, not a PyPI copy). Oracle: LQR must place all closed-loop eigenvalues in the left half-plane and drive the perturbed state to ~0.

world_closure.note: original world unrecoverable from evidence; this pins the world from here on
